title.zh: 将Apayao 省 Conner 市镇 Guina-ang 描笼涯的 Corner 中央国立中学的 Guina-ang 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Corner Central National High School - Guina-ang Annex in Barangay Guina-ang, Municipality of Conner, Province of Apayao from the Conner Central National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Guina-ang National High School and Approriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Guina-ang của Trường Trung học Trung tâm Corner Quốc gia tại Barangay Guina-ang, Đô thị Conner, Tỉnh Apayao khỏi Trường Trung học Trung tâm Conner Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Guina-ang ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษากลาง Corner แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Guina-ang เทศบาล Conner จังหวัด Apayao ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษากลาง Conner แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Guina-ang, Sekolah Menengah Pusat Corner Nasional di Barangay Guina-ang, Kotamadya Conner, Provinsi Apayao dari Sekolah Menengah Pusat Conner Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Guina-ang, Sekolah Menengah Pusat Corner Kebangsaan di Barangay Guina-ang, Perbandaran Conner, Wilayah Apayao daripada Sekolah Menengah Pusat Conner Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan

text.en: The Conner Central National High School – Guina-ang Annex in Barangay Guina-ang, Municipality of Conner, Province of Apayao is hereby separated from the Conner Central National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Guina-ang national High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Conner Central National High School – Guina-ang Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Guina-ang National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Guina-ang National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Conner Central National High School – Guina-ang Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
